{{Quote|I heard another Republic fleet was wiped out in this sector! I hope they don't find the Jedi here!|A settler of Dantooine|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''battle''' occurred in the [[Raioballo sector/Legends|Raioballo sector]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]] between the [[Unidentified Republic fleet]] and the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]. The Sith Empire wiped out the Republic fleet and news of the battle traveled at least as far as [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].

==Behind the scenes==
The battle of the Raioballo sector was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' by a female NPC settler of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] after the player has constructed a lightsaber and exited the [[Jedi Enclave]].
